abstract.text: Every clique of an undirected graph’s simple graph whose size is in a range, once each, lazily,
order (by vertex index). The order is by the cliques’ first vertex in
, then depth first, each clique followed by its extensions by
later vertices in ascending index. The sequence holds the graph, so iterating again gives the
same cliques. O(n + m) before the first clique, O(d) bitset words per clique for degeneracy d.
